Definition: Whether credential is accepted or mandatory for SIM card activation and mobile service registration
Comments: SIM card registration using biometric national ID is mandatory in Mauritania by law. The ARE (Telecommunications Regulatory Authority) issued formal notices to operators Mattel, Mauritel and Chinguitel in January 2026 for failures in biometric subscriber identification compliance. In October 2023, ARE ordered deactivation of SIM cards lacking biometric identification. The law conditions sale, marketing, or activation of any SIM on prior biometric identification.
